disputed: Whether this reflects genuine authoritarian intent (as 'No Kings' organizers argued) or is better characterized as crude trolling/political theater, as the administration and allies like Speaker Johnson framed it, is a matter of interpretation, not an established fact.

items: On October 18, 2025, an estimated 7 million people participated in more than 2,500-2,700 'No Kings' protests across all 50 states, organized against what organizers called the administration's 'authoritarian power grab.' (Variety (https://variety.com/2025/digital/news/trump-ai-video-no-kings-fighter-jet-brown-sludge-protestors-1236556347/))

That evening, Trump posted a 19-second AI-generated video to Truth Social depicting himself wearing a crown, piloting a fighter jet labeled 'King Trump,' and dropping brown sludge resembling feces onto protesters in a scene resembling Times Square, set to Kenny Loggins' 'Danger Zone.' The video specifically targeted an identifiable individual, 23-year-old progressive commentator Harry Sisson, shown being hit by the payload. (NBC News (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-posts-ai-video-dumping-no-kings-protesters-rcna238521))

The video originated from another X account and was reposted by Trump; it was shared on both his personal Truth Social account and the official White House Rapid Response X account. (Deadline (https://deadline.com/2025/10/kenny-loggins-trump-ai-no-kings-video-1236592144/))

An NBC News review found Trump posted dozens of AI-generated videos over the preceding nine months, with roughly half posted in August and September 2025 alone. (NBC News (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-posts-ai-video-dumping-no-kings-protesters-rcna238521))
sections.label: What happened

items: Kenny Loggins publicly demanded the unauthorized use of his recording be removed, saying the video was 'created with the sole purpose of dividing us.' (Deadline (https://deadline.com/2025/10/kenny-loggins-trump-ai-no-kings-video-1236592144/))

Sisson said he was directly targeted and asked reporters to press Trump on it; VP JD Vance responded to him on X saying he would ask Trump. (NBC News (https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-posts-ai-video-dumping-no-kings-protesters-rcna238521))

Asked at a press conference whether it was appropriate for the president to post a video of himself 'pooping on the American people,' House Speaker Mike Johnson responded only that 'the president uses social media to make a point.' (Deadline (https://deadline.com/2025/10/kenny-loggins-trump-ai-no-kings-video-1236592144/))

Hunter Biden called the video 'juvenile' and said it amounted to 'painting a target' on Sisson specifically. (Yahoo/HuffPost (https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/exclusive-hunter-biden-blasts-trump-144753233.html))
sections.label: Reactions

summary: Note on category: unlike other entries, this is not a financial corruption or oversight-circumvention case. It concerns presidential conduct and use of official communication channels to respond to mass protest, included under the broader 'unethical/awful' scope of this project rather than 'corruption' specifically.
title: Presidential conduct: AI video mocking 'No Kings' protesters
